$comment: Declared folder taxonomy for the Herdr app's sidebar: the jk-spaces mod files each space under the group naming its repo (worktrees follow their repo), the rest go to `fallback`. Order here IS the sidebar order. `paths` (WORK: IuRoot) is a root dir name, so every repo under it files into the group without being listed. Members that are not open are skipped, so listing a repo early costs nothing. `make herdr-app-setup` links this file to ~/.config/herdr-app/groups.json. Every member that exists on the mini also gets a mini space from `make herdr-app-setup` (it runs on the MacBook after a pull that touches this directory), terminal or not. `noMiniSpace`: members that keep their sidebar place but get no mini space.
